remarks: Nestled within the Little Valley Rod & Gun Club, this charming, move-in ready, partially furnished, 2-bedroom, 1-bath cabin offers the perfect retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Step through the sliding glass doors from the spacious L-shaped side porch into a warm and inviting living room featuring vaulted ceilings and a cozy pellet stove. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the kitchen, with a charming breakfast nook nestled between the two spaces—an ideal spot for morning coffee or casual dining. Just off the breakfast nook is a versatile room that can function as a bedroom or home office, providing flexible space for guests, remote work, or hobbies. The cabin also features a cozy primary bedroom and a versatile loft, offering additional space for guests, recreation, or storage. Just off the second porch, a convenient laundry area provides the perfect spot to drop sandy towels and lake gear, making cleanup after a day on the water quick and easy. Outside, two storage sheds provide ample space for tools, outdoor equipment, lake toys, recreational gear, and seasonal items and the Golf Cart is included. The Club offers an exceptional collection of outdoor amenities designed for year-round recreation and family enjoyment. Set along a picturesque lake, residents can enjoy a sandy beach ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and kayaking. The waterfront also features a slide and diving board, providing fun for all ages. A playground offers endless entertainment for children, while the pavilion serves as the perfect gathering place for picnics, celebrations, or simply relaxing in the shade. Miles of scenic trails on 83  meander throughout the 83 common acres, offering excellent opportunities for hiking and 4-wheeling during the warmer months and snowmobiling in winter. Whether you seek outdoor adventure or peaceful relaxation, this setting delivers in every season. This charming, fully furnished cabin combines comfort, privacy, and lakeside living. Tucked away in a tranquil setting yet conveniently located just 10 minutes to Ellicottville and minutes from Holiday Valley skiing, golf, and year-round recreation.
